page.overview:
Who is Edgar Grant?

In the game, Edgar uses the alias "Alan Smithee" while acting as a sneaker. During the introduction video, he debriefs Nina on the mission, which involves infiltrating the Amphitrite to create a video recon of the meeting of the executives of Kometa. Edgar instructs Nina to enter an underground fighting tournament onboard the ship and keep a low profile while awaiting further orders. The following day after the tournament, Edgar contacts Nina and tells her to go to work. He debriefs her on her next objectives and guides her throughout.

Edgar eventually gets ambushed at the heliport by a sniper and several soldiers, during which he is assisted by Nina in killing them. Once John Doe is found dead inside the large freezer, Edgar warns Nina that it is a trap set up by Bryce Adams. After Bryce escapes the freezer, Nina scans John's body and the weapon used by Edgar. Nina later kills Bryce and recovers the GPS device. Edgar later informs Nina about Kometa and the intention of photographing the meetings in order to get closer to the truth.

Nina eventually encounters Edgar at the heliport and gets ambushed by several soldiers. The two defeat them, and Edgar informs Nina about one of Kometa's ships sinking in the middle of the Atlantic. He also reveals that someone broadcasted a 30 second video of the same ship's explosion on the internet. Edgar gives Nina the "Stingray" and shoots a ladder down in order to give Nina access to Lana Lei's apartment. Upon the documentation of the meeting, Edgar instructs Nina to find the computer that John set up and upload the footage to the CIA. He later tells Nina to meet him at the heliport.

Soon after, Nina escapes her prison cell at the Solitaria Penitentiary. Edgar later informs Nina that the culprit responsible for the video of the exploding ship is someone on the island and instructs her to find him. He also informs Nina about the arrival of the Tekken Force. After Nina obtains Enrique's prints and unlocks Lukas' cell door, Edgar calls Nina and informs her that Enrique and the Tekken Force are heading underground. He later assists Nina during the fight with Type-J by activating the prototype model of Salacia. When Nina defeats Type-J or lures it to the Salacia prototype, Edgar will fire the weapon, knocking it down.
